name: IrfanView
price: Free for private, non-commercial and educational use; commercial licence US$18 / EUR 15 (perpetual)
engine: Own decoders plus plug-ins (LibRaw, libjxl, libavif, Pdfium); video through Windows DirectShow/Media Foundation codecs
summary: IrfanView is a tiny, very fast Windows image viewer that has been around since 1996 and reads an enormous list of formats through plug-ins. Besides viewing it does batch conversion, basic editing, scanning, printing and slideshows, all driven by many hotkeys.
where_it_wins: Huge format list, including rare and retro formats
Image editing, paint plug-in, effects, Photoshop 8BF filters
Search by EXIF/IPTC and text, not only names
Slideshows saved as EXE, screensaver or MP4
Runs on very old Windows versions and from a USB stick
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon)
Plays MKV, WebM, AVI itself with built-in VLC, no codec packs
Videos and photos in one grid, skimming with the arrow keys, subtitles, audio tracks
Archives and comics (ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ, CBR) open like folders
Folder tiles with previews, dual pane with F5/F6, undo of file actions
Regular expression search through all subfolders
Free for everyone, also commercially, and open source; sandboxed, never online

free.note: Free for private, non-commercial and educational use; commercial use US$18 / EUR 15 per licence

native_apple_silicon.note: No macOS version; FAQ points Mac users to Wine/WineBottler. Native builds exist for Windows 32/64-bit and Windows ARM64

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account; FAQ: no spyware; 'no Shareware messages'

dark_light_setting.note: Dark mode option in Properties->Viewing (since 4.65), independent of Windows

languages_20.note: About 34 languages as separate add-on downloads (19 updated for 4.76); English and German built in

folder_browsing.note: Browses the folder of the opened file and a Thumbnails window with folder tree; no import

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnails window with folder tree; folders are shown in the tree, not as preview tiles

list_view.note: Thumbnails window View menu: Thumbnails, Tiles, Details, List

recursive_search.note: Search files (Ctrl+F) in the folder and subfolders by filename pattern, date, EXIF/IPTC or text

regex_search.note: Filename patterns (wildcards) only; no regular expressions documented

network_shares_fast.note: Known as fast and compact for browsing; no specific network optimisation documented

multiple_windows.note: Ctrl+N opens the file in a new instance; option 'Only 1 instance' can be switched

bookmarks.note: Thumbnails window menu Favorite folders (max 15, new in 4.76); 14 favourite folders for Move/Copy

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP via the included/optional plug-ins; HEIC also needs Microsoft's HEVC extensions

img_raw.note: CamRAW plug-in (LibRaw 0.22.3): CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG, ORF, RAF, RW2 and more

img_psd_exr.note: PSD built in, EXR via plug-in

img_svg_pdf.note: SVG and PDF via plug-ins (new SVG plug-in 4.76.1, PDF via Pdfium plug-in; Ghostscript for PS/EPS/AI)

img_animated.note: Animated GIF (first viewer with it), animated WebP, animated AVIF (4.76), MNG/APNG via plug-in

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys / Page keys browse the folder

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom, pan, rotate; rotation can also be saved (lossless JPG rotation)

slideshow.note: Slideshow dialog with timer, random, loop, transitions; can save as EXE/SCR or MP4

slideshow_recursive.note: Thumbnails can load all subfolders and start a slideshow from that list (Ctrl+W); videos in a slideshow depend on installed codecs

auto_enhance_view.note: Auto adjust colours (Shift+U) and colour corrections apply to the image in memory; you must not save, but it is an edit, not a view filter

file_info_exif.note: Image->Information and EXIF/IPTC dialogs; video codec name shown, no bitrate details

wrong_extension_note.note: Option 'Ask to rename if incorrect extension' (Properties->File Handling)

video_native.note: Plays via Windows codecs (DirectShow / Windows Media Player plug-in): 'IrfanView is NOT playing a video, it just starts the installed codecs'

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: AVI, WMV, ASF built in; MKV/WebM via plug-in and installed codecs (FAQ recommends K-Lite Codec Pack)

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Thumbnails window shows video files with images; frame extraction for thumbnails depends on installed codecs

video_skim_arrows.note: Arrow keys browse files; video seeking only via the play bar (B toggles it in full screen)

subtitles_embedded.note: Video/Sound options are only internal/external player, DirectShow, loop, hide playbar, window size; the version history since 1996 adds no subtitle feature; 'IrfanView is NOT playing a video, it just starts the installed codecs'

subtitles_external_files.note: Video/Sound options are only internal/external player, DirectShow, loop, hide playbar, window size; the version history since 1996 adds no subtitle feature; 'IrfanView is NOT playing a video, it just starts the installed codecs'

audio_track_choice.note: Video/Sound options are only internal/external player, DirectShow, loop, hide playbar, window size; the version history since 1996 adds no track selection; 'IrfanView is NOT playing a video, it just starts the installed codecs'

playback_speed.note: Video/Sound options are only internal/external player, DirectShow, loop, hide playbar, window size; the version history since 1996 adds no speed control (only GIF/ANI/PNG animation speed); 'IrfanView is NOT playing a video, it just starts the installed codecs'

control_bar_movable.note: Simple play bar; option only to hide it in full screen

playlist.note: Slideshow file lists (Slideshow.lst, TXT) can hold images; no video playlist

saved_playlists.note: Slideshow lists can be saved as TXT and run again

pip.note: Not among the Video/Sound options or in the version history

music_mode.note: Plays audio files (MP3, FLAC, WAV ...) in the main window; background sound for slideshows

streaming_urls.note: Plays local files through installed codecs; no URL/stream opening in menus or history (FTP plug-in only uploads)

video_filters_enhance.note: Colour corrections apply to images; video player context menu only copies a frame and changes volume

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Not a shell extension: 'IrfanView does NOT show/change anything in Windows File Explorer' (a separate Shell Extension plug-in adds context menus only)

archives_as_folders.note: No archive browsing in the format list

manga_two_page.note: No two-page or right-to-left reading mode in menus or version history (Panorama only joins images into a new file)

rename_trash.note: Rename (F2), Delete (Del); Move/Copy create missing target folders

move_copy.note: Move (F7) / Copy (F8) to favourite folders; drag and drop in Thumbnails window

dual_pane.note: Single Thumbnails pane; Move/Copy via dialogs

undo_file_actions.note: Undo covers image edits only (up to 20 steps)

image_editing.note: Crop, resize, colour, effects, paint plug-in, text, watermark, save in many formats

library_catalog.note: No database; tagging only marks files for the session (X / Shift+X)

cloud_sync.note: Email and FTP upload plug-ins; no cloud sync

keyboard_first.note: 'Many hotkeys'; nearly every menu has a key

custom_shortcuts.note: Menu hotkeys changeable by right-click on a menu item (since 4.56)

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Keyboard Shortcuts topic in the help file (F1); not a printable sheet in the app

boss_key.note: M minimizes IrfanView to the taskbar; the changelog calls it 'BOSS-Key'. One window only, nothing else hidden

app_sandbox.note: no macOS version (FAQ: only via Wine/WineBottler)

no_network.note: Viewing is offline; optional email/FTP plug-ins go online

notarized_attested.note: Closed source Windows binary; SHA-256 checksums published for plug-ins

mac_app_store.note: no macOS version (FAQ: only via Wine/WineBottler)
